name: On Air Island: Survival Live Show
source:
"On Air Island" is centered around a reality television show called "Don’t Stop Supporting Me!", in which seven participants are marooned on a remote island and armed with only one resource: donations from viewers. With no traditional supplies, the cast members are forced to rely entirely on the generosity of the audience to endure a week-long battle for survival.

Who will die? Who will survive? 
The contestants' fates rest in your hands!
translation:
《空中岛上》以一档名为“不要停止支持我！”的真人秀节目为中心，其中七名参与者被困在一个偏远的岛屿上，只有一种资源：观众的捐款。由于没有传统物资，演员们被迫完全依靠观众的慷慨来忍受长达一周的生存之战。

谁会死？谁能活下来？
参赛者的命运掌握在你的手中！
